areaCode.description: Coarse functional area, e.g. STOR, RCV, PACK, STAGE.

zoneCode.description: Behavioral zone, e.g. AMB, CHL, FRZ, HAZ, FWD, RSV, CPK. CPK = case-pick faces whose capacity slotting plans in cases. Free-form, so any [A-Z0-9]+ code is accepted and none is validated against a list (ADR 0042).

temperatureClass.description: A zone's thermal behaviour. PlacementRules match on it.
temperatureClass.title: TemperatureClass

hazmat.description: Whether this zone is rated for hazardous materials. JSON null is accepted and means the same as false (the default).

bayPitchM.description: Optional bay-pitch override for the travel graph's estimated-distance fallback (ADR-0017). Omitted (or null) keeps the service default (1.2 m). Must be sent together with `levelPitchM`: a one-sided pitch is rejected 422 `invalid-pitch`.

levelPitchM.description: Optional level-pitch override for the travel graph's estimated vertical spacing (ADR-0017). Omitted (or null) keeps the service default (1.5 m). Must be sent together with `bayPitchM`: a one-sided pitch is rejected 422 `invalid-pitch`.

gln.description: A GS1 Global Location Number (ADR-0045): 13 digits whose last digit is the GS1 mod-10 check digit of the first twelve (weights 3 and 1, alternating from the right). The pattern only checks the shape; the check digit is verified by the service (422 `invalid-gln`). A GLN identifies exactly one site, zone or slot (409 `gln-already-assigned`). Optional everywhere; omitted when none was recorded.
gln.title: Gln

withGln.summary: A zone carrying a GS1 Global Location Number (ADR-0045)

casePickFaces.summary: A case-pick (CPK) zone, a convention on the free-form zone code (ADR 0042)
